SOCIAL STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #13
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Seasons in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Seasons in the County.
   B. Treat Seasons in the County as rumours only.
   C. Explain Seasons in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Seasons in the County never happens in Kenya.

2. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Hide all money underground
   B. Avoid saving forever
   C. Ignore prices in shops
   D. Plan income and spending wisely

3. Which statement about Interdependence of people is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Interdependence of people as rumours only.
   B. Explain Interdependence of people with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Interdependence of people.
   D. Say Interdependence of people never happens in Kenya.

4. Which statement about Economic activities in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Economic activities in the County.
   B. Say Economic activities in the County never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Economic activities in the County as rumours only.
   D. Explain Economic activities in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

5. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nakuru
   B. Kisumu
   C. Nairobi
   D. Mombasa

6. Which statement about Population Distribution is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Population Distribution as rumours only.
   B. Explain Population Distribution with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Population Distribution.
   D. Say Population Distribution never happens in Kenya.

7. Which statement about Compass Direction is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Compass Direction with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Compass Direction as rumours only.
   C. Say Compass Direction never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Compass Direction.

8. Which statement about Enterprise Project at School is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Enterprise Project at School never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Enterprise Project at School.
   C. Explain Enterprise Project at School with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Enterprise Project at School as rumours only.

9. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Avoiding all community work
   B. Littering in markets
   C. Destroying road signs
   D. Obeying laws and caring for public property

10. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace the compass rose
   B. Name the president
   C. Explain symbols used on a map
   D. Measure rainfall only

11. Which statement about Physical features in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Physical features in the County.
   B. Treat Physical features in the County as rumours only.
   C. Explain Physical features in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Physical features in the County never happens in Kenya.

12. Which statement about Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County..

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Interdependence of people and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Population Distribution and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain The School and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. C — Explain Seasons in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

2. D — Plan income and spending wisely

3. B — Explain Interdependence of people with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

4. D — Explain Economic activities in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

5. C — Nairobi

6. B — Explain Population Distribution with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

7. A — Explain Compass Direction with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

8. C — Explain Enterprise Project at School with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

9. D — Obeying laws and caring for public property

10. C — Explain symbols used on a map

11. C — Explain Physical features in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

12. A — Explain Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Interdependence of people; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Population Distribution; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County.; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of The School; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
